items.name_en: Unified Emergency Number 911 (Unified Security Operations Center)
items.description_en: The one number to call in Riyadh for any emergency (police, fire and rescue, traffic, road security); official statements tell people in the Riyadh, Makkah, Madinah and Eastern regions to call 911 instead of the separate agency numbers.
items.description_ar: الاتصال بالرقم (911) في مناطق مكة المكرمة، والمدينة المنورة، والرياض، والمنطقة الشرقية في الحالات الطارئة.
items.notes: Arabic name is my wording, not copied from an official page. SPA (1 Oct 2026, Civil Defense): 911 in Makkah, Madinah, Riyadh and Eastern regions, 998 elsewhere. SPA (21 Apr 2026, Ministry of Interior): 911 in those four regions, 999 elsewhere. SPA 2024: 911 centres run 24/7 and route each call to the right agency. Older SPA items (2024) list only Makkah, Riyadh and Eastern; Madinah was added later. The ambulance number 997 is still published separately by the Red Crescent. Cost not stated in sources loaded.

items.name_ar: الخدمة الإسعافية - هيئة الهلال الأحمر السعودي (997)
items.description_en: Call for an ambulance or to report a medical emergency anywhere in the Kingdom.
items.description_ar: طلب خدمات الإسعاف عبر الاتصال بهيئة الهلال الأحمر السعودي على الرقم (997).
items.notes: Listed on srca.gov.sa as 'للبلاغات الإسعافية 997' / 'Ambulances 997'. Hours not printed next to the number on the pages loaded; treated as an emergency line. NCMH's contact page labels 911 as 'الإسعاف', so 911 also reaches ambulance dispatch in Riyadh.

items.description_en: Fire, rescue and civil-defence emergencies; in Riyadh the Civil Defense tells residents to call 911, and 998 is for regions without a 911 centre.
items.description_ar: الاتصال بالرقم (911) في مناطق مكة المكرمة، والمدينة المنورة، والرياض، والمنطقة الشرقية، وبالرقم (998) في بقية مناطق المملكة، في الحالات الطارئة.
items.notes: 998.gov.sa home page shows 'نحن معكم 911 أو 998' / 'Call us 911 or 998'. For Riyadh, list 911 first.

items.description_en: Police number; in Riyadh the Ministry of Interior directs reports to 911, and 999 is for regions without a 911 centre.
items.notes: my.gov.sa labels it 'الشرطة / Police'; srca.gov.sa labels it 'الدوريات الأمنية / Security Patrols'. SPA (21 Apr 2026): 911 in Makkah, Madinah, Riyadh and Eastern regions, 999 in the rest of the Kingdom. Not confirmed whether 999 dialled in Riyadh is forwarded to 911.

items.description_en: Highway and road-security reports outside the 911 regions; in the Riyadh region use 911.
items.notes: SPA statements (2026) list 996 only for 'the rest of the Kingdom', after 911 for Makkah, Madinah, Riyadh and Eastern regions.

items.name_en: General Directorate of Narcotics Control reports line (995)
items.name_ar: رقم بلاغات المديرية العامة لمكافحة المخدرات (995)
items.description_en: Confidential reports about drug smuggling or dealing.
items.description_ar: رقم بلاغات المديرية العامة لمكافحة المخدرات (995)، وعبر البريد الإلكتروني 995@gdnc.gov.sa، وستعالج جميع البلاغات بسرية تامة.
items.notes: Latest SPA item loaded with this wording is Dec 2024. Not an emergency-response line.

items.description_en: Border Guard and coastal emergencies outside the 911 regions; not normally needed in Riyadh, where 911 is used.
items.notes: SPA Border Guard statements (Mar-Apr 2026): 911 in Makkah, Madinah, Riyadh and Eastern regions, and 994, 999, 996 in the rest of the Kingdom. stc labels 994 'Coastguard'.

items.description_en: Traffic police number published by the operator stc; in Riyadh traffic reports go through 911.
items.notes: Only confirmation loaded is stc's emergency-numbers page (operator, not a government page). Not found on moi.gov.sa, srca.gov.sa or my.gov.sa contact pages. Arabic name is my translation.

items.description_en: General emergency short code that stc lists for mobile phones.
items.notes: Only source loaded is stc's page, which lists '112 Emergency' beside '911 Unified Emergency Number'. No government page loaded confirms where 112 is routed. Arabic name is my translation.

items.description_en: Free 24/7 Ministry of Health line for medical consultations with doctors, health reports and complaints.
items.description_ar: تقديم الاستشارات الطبية من خلال أطباء يعملون على مدار الساعة، واستقبال ورصد بلاغات المرضى، واستقبال جميع الشكاوى والملاحظات.
items.notes: MoH contact page: 'From within the Kingdom for medical consultations and receiving reports (24/7): 937; from outside the Kingdom: 00966920005937'. my.gov.sa calls it a toll-free hotline. Answering languages not published on the pages loaded.

items.description_en: For suspected poisoning, 937 gives advice and guidance; call 911 or 997 if the person is in danger.
items.description_ar: تقديم النصائح والإرشادات الهامة لحالات التسمم.
items.notes: No separate national poison-control number was found on moh.gov.sa; the official route is 937. The advice to call 911/997 for life-threatening cases is mine, not quoted from MoH.

items.description_en: National health app for instant medical consultations, appointment booking at health centres, health records and sick leaves.
items.description_ar: صحتي هي منصة إلكترونية لتقديم الخدمات الصحية للأفراد في المملكة العربية السعودية. تتيح المنصة للمستخدم إمكانية الوصول إلى المعلومات الصحية والحصول على عدد من الخدمات الصحية.
items.notes: MoH page lists 'Instant Medical Consultation Service' / 'خدمة الاستشارات الطبية الفورية' and appointment booking. sehhaty.sa/en and /ar return 404; the landing page is https://sehhaty.sa/ with an in-page English toggle. Also on Huawei AppGallery: https://appgallery.huawei.com/#/app/C102530755.

items.name_en: Saudi Red Crescent Beneficiary Services Call Center
items.name_ar: مركز اتصال خدمات المستفيدين - هيئة الهلال الأحمر السعودي
items.description_en: Non-emergency enquiries to the Red Crescent (services, training, complaints); for an ambulance call 997.
items.notes: Hours not published on the page loaded. The SRCA site also lists a WhatsApp bot 'هلال بوت' on 00966533889977.

items.description_en: Call 937 for a psychological or mental-health consultation or to book an appointment at a government clinic.
items.description_ar: يمكنك طلب استشارة نفسية أو حجز موعد في العيادات الحكومية عبر خدمة 937.
items.notes: NCMH FAQ (site updated 12 Oct 2026) says the centre has no hotline of its own and points to 937. my.gov.sa: medical, psychological and mental-health consultations from doctors available 24/7 via 937. Languages not published.

items.name_en: National Center for Mental Health Promotion (NCMH)
items.description_en: Government centre publishing mental-health guidance in Arabic and a map of mental-health clinics; it is not a helpline.
items.notes: Clinic map: https://ncmh.org.sa/map. Office line 011-8800865 and info@ncmh.org.sa (administrative, not counselling). FAQ describes the Qareboon app as a library of awareness material; no store link was verified. No English version of the site was found.

items.description_en: Counselling number still printed on my.gov.sa but contradicted by the NCMH's own site; do not publish without checking.
items.notes: CONFLICT: my.gov.sa health-care page says counselling is available by phone on 920033360 or the Qareboon app. NCMH's own FAQ says 'المركز نفسه لا يوفر خطًا ساخنًا للاستشارات' and refers callers to 937, and the number does not appear on NCMH's contact page. Likely retired.

items.description_en: Free 24/7 line of the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development for reporting abuse or violence within a family, for yourself or someone else.
items.description_ar: مركز لتلقي بلاغات العنف والإيذاء داخل نطاق الأسرة، يستقبل الاتصالات من مختلف مناطق المملكة على مدار الساعة وطوال أيام الأسبوع من خلال أخصائيات نفسية واجتماعيات.
items.notes: Also by email 1919@hrsd.gov.sa and the HRSD app. Languages not published. In immediate danger call 911.

items.description_en: Free confidential line run with the National Family Safety Program for children and teenagers under 18 who need advice or support.
items.description_ar: الخط المجاني لمساندة الطفل (116111) جهة تقدم المشورة والمساندة والدعم بكل سرية وخصوصية.
items.notes: Number and 'free' confirmed by a Ministry of Education news page (1443 AH, about 2021-22). The National Family Safety Program site (nfsp.org.sa) did not resolve, so current hours and languages are unconfirmed; an unofficial directory lists 07:00-23:00 daily in Arabic and English. English name is a translation.

items.description_en: Government body that receives human-rights complaints.
items.notes: Hours not published on the page loaded. English URL not verified. App links seen on the site were not checked.

items.name_en: Saudi Energy (the electricity company) customer service
items.description_en: Electricity company number for outages, electrical hazards and billing.
items.notes: se.com.sa (the Saudi Electricity Company domain) now carries the title 'السعودية للطاقة / Saudi Energy' and its social accounts are @SaudiEnergy; the footer reads 'رقم خدمة العملاء: 933 / Customer Service Number: 933'. I did not load an official announcement of the rename. WhatsApp link on the site: +966920001100. Hours not printed next to the number.

items.name_en: National Water Company unified contact center
items.name_ar: شركة المياه الوطنية - مركز الاتصال الموحد
items.description_en: Water and sewage customer service, complaints and enquiries.
items.notes: Android app seen on the site: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=sa.com.nwc.mobile (not checked).

items.name_en: National Water Company Water Reporting Center (931)
items.description_en: Report water leaks, cuts and sewage overflows.
items.notes: The numbers often cited online for NWC, 939 and 920001744, do not appear on the NWC pages loaded; the site lists 931 and 8004411110 instead. What kinds of reports 931 takes is my reading of the name.

items.description_en: Report municipal problems such as road damage, waste, flooding in streets or public-health nuisances.
items.notes: Printed as 'بلاغات البلدية 940' on balady.gov.sa and momah.gov.sa. English name and the examples in the description are mine. Android link for the Balady app was not verified. Hours not published.

items.description_en: Enquiries about municipal e-services on the Balady platform.
items.notes: Hours not published on the pages loaded.

items.description_en: Contact number of the telecom regulator, for problems a mobile or internet provider has not resolved.
items.notes: Number confirmed on cst.gov.sa beside info@cst.gov.sa. The complaint-escalation use is my description; the complaints page itself was not loaded. Operators' own fault lines were not verified.

items.name_en: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development call center
items.name_ar: وزارة الموارد البشرية والتنمية الاجتماعية - مركز الاتصال
items.description_en: Labour questions and complaints: wages, contracts, disputes with an employer, social services.
items.notes: The page prints ministry office hours Sunday-Thursday 8:00-14:20 next to the number; call-centre hours and languages are not stated. App links were found on hrsd.gov.sa but not opened. Topic examples are mine.

items.description_en: Residency (iqama), exit/re-entry and passport-office enquiries.
items.notes: Also 992@gdp.gov.sa. Hours and languages not published on the pages loaded. Topic examples are mine.

items.description_en: Support for the Absher platform (Ministry of Interior e-services).
items.notes: Shown as 'Contact Us 920020405' in the Absher Individuals footer. Arabic label is the standard footer wording, not copied from the Arabic page.

items.description_en: Platform and contact number for domestic workers and their employers: contracts, recruitment and complaints.
items.notes: musaned.com.sa now redirects to musaned.gov.sa. The Arabic home page prints 'الإتاحة: 24/7' beside 920002866. Topic list is mine.

items.description_en: Official Civil Defense site with statements, safety material and e-services.
Civil Defense gallery of public safety guidance.
items.notes: Both URLs return 200 with the right titles, but I did not review the items inside. Safety services menu: https://998.gov.sa/ar/Page/Menu/List/Salama%20Menu/ and https://998.gov.sa/en/Page/Menu/List/Salama%20Menu/.

items.description_en: Explains the cell-broadcast alerts that Civil Defense sends to mobile phones in an emergency and what the siren tones mean.
items.description_ar: هي منصة إلكترونية للإنذار المبكر في حالات الطوارئ لبث الرسائل التحذيرية باستخدام خدمة البث الخلوي، تُبث من خلالها رسائل تحذيرية ذات نغمة مميزة إلى الهواتف المتصلة بشبكات الاتصالات المتنقلة لتحذير السكان، وإبلاغهم بما يجب اتخاذه لسلامتهم وحمايتهم.
items.notes: English guide PDF: https://998.gov.sa/English/Documents/National%20Early%20Warning%20Platform%20.pdf. The Arabic home page links a PDF titled 'منصة الإنذار المبكر ومدلولات صافرات الإنذار'. Alerts arrive automatically; there is no sign-up.

items.description_en: Ministry of Interior portal with security statements and links to Absher.
items.notes: The site does not list emergency numbers. Office line 0114011111, Sunday-Thursday 8:00-14:30, care@moi.gov.sa.

items.description_en: Ministry of Health portal.
Red Crescent site: ambulance service, first-aid training and volunteering.
items.notes: The older address srca.org.sa timed out and www.srca.org.sa did not resolve; the live site is srca.gov.sa.

items.description_en: Red Crescent app for sending an ambulance request with your location.
items.description_ar: يتيح التطبيق للمستخدمين إنشاء رسالة على الهاتف المحمول والاتصال بفريق الطوارئ، وطلب المساعدة عن طريق إرسال نداء استغاثة، ومعرفة حالة الاتصال وتتبع المسار.
items.notes: Both store links come from srca.gov.sa and the my.gov.sa app directory (entry updated 2026-08-10), but the Google Play link returned 404 on 2026-10-12 (also with gl=SA) and the App Store link returned 429 (rate limit), so neither could be opened. Check on a phone in Saudi Arabia before publishing. An emergency feature inside Tawakkalna was not confirmed.

items.description_en: Ministry of Interior e-services for residents: iqama, visas, traffic, appointments.
items.notes: One URL; language is switched on the page. Huawei: https://appgallery.huawei.com/#/app/C101687609. Service examples are mine.

items.description_en: National services app (SDAIA) holding digital documents and government services, including organ-donor registration.
items.notes: Contact page prints 'رقم التواصل 8001289999'. English is an in-page toggle; https://ta.sdaia.gov.sa/en/ returns 'Request Rejected'. The App Store link returned 429 when opened; it is the link printed on ta.sdaia.gov.sa and my.gov.sa.

items.description_en: Unified government portal and service directory; Amer answers general questions about government e-services.
items.notes: my.gov.sa blocks non-browser requests (403), but opens in a browser. Service directory: https://my.gov.sa/en/services, app directory: https://my.gov.sa/en/govApps.

items.description_en: Official state news agency; the place to check official statements.
Riyadh Municipality portal for city services.
items.notes: Page titles are 'موقع أمانة الرياض' and 'Riyadh Municipality Portal'; the full Arabic name given here is the common form, not copied from the page. Municipal reports go to 940.

items.description_en: Royal Commission for Riyadh City official site.
items.notes: my.gov.sa's agency directory lists 19998 for RCRC, but I did not find it on rcrc.gov.sa, so it is left out.

items.description_en: Riyadh Metro and bus routes, tickets and journey planner; customer service on 19933.
items.description_ar: فريق العمل جاهز لخدمتك على مدار الساعة طوال أيام الأسبوع، اتصل بمركز خدمة العملاء على الرقم 19933.
items.notes: The app is now called 'darb / درب' in both stores. riyadhbus.sa and riyadhmetro.sa did not resolve. rpt.sa returns 403 to non-browser requests but opens in a browser.

items.description_en: Civil aviation regulator; passenger rights and aviation notices.
items.notes: my.gov.sa's directory lists 1929 for GACA; not confirmed on gaca.gov.sa, so left out.

items.description_en: Riyadh airport site for flight status and passenger information.
items.notes: https://www.kkia.sa/ar redirected to the English page. Arabic name is the standard name, not copied from the site. Operator site https://www.riyadhairports.com/en also loads.

items.description_en: Ministry of Education portal; school announcements.
items.notes: my.gov.sa's directory lists 19996 for the ministry; not confirmed on moe.gov.sa, so left out.

items.description_en: Official weather forecasts and warnings.

items.name_en: Ehsan - national platform for charitable work
items.description_en: Government-run platform for donating money to vetted charitable causes.
items.description_ar: إحسان؛ منصة وطنية للعمل الخيري، تسهل عملية التبرع للفئات الأشد احتياجاً بسهولة وأمان وموثوقية.
items.notes: English is an in-page toggle marked 'تجريبي' (beta); /en and /ar return 404. The Android package name shows SDAIA as publisher. Phone taken from the tel: link on the home page.

items.description_en: Official portal to find and register for volunteering opportunities and log volunteer hours.
items.description_ar: منصة وطنية موحدة، تهدف إلى تنظيم العمل التطوعي من خلال مجموعة من الخدمات، تشمل إدارة الفرص، الانضمام للمبادرات، ومشاركة الأفكار، ضمن بيئة موحّدة تُعزز الأثر.
items.notes: 'Log volunteer hours' is my addition. No phone number confirmed.

items.name_ar: التطوع في هيئة الهلال الأحمر السعودي
items.description_en: Register as a Red Crescent volunteer.
items.notes: Linked from srca.gov.sa as 'سجل معنا / Register with us'. Arabic name is my wording.

items.name_en: First Responder Program - Al-Mustajeeb app (Saudi Red Crescent)
items.description_en: Trained volunteers are alerted to nearby medical emergencies so they can help before the ambulance arrives.
items.notes: Both store links open (200). Eligibility rules were not read.

items.name_en: Life Ambassador first-aid training (Saudi Red Crescent)
items.description_en: Red Crescent first-aid courses for the public; register on the training platform.
items.notes: Registration link on srca.gov.sa is https://mutaaheb.srca.org.sa/, which redirects to https://training.srca.gov.sa/ ('المنصة التدريبية'). Fees were not checked.

items.name_ar: منصة ساهم - مركز الملك سلمان للإغاثة والأعمال الإنسانية
items.description_en: Donate to the King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center's relief campaigns abroad.

items.name_en: Organ donor registration (Tawakkalna / Saudi Center for Organ Transplantation)
items.description_en: Register as an organ donor after death in the Tawakkalna app (Services > Health Services > Organ Donation); the data goes to the Saudi Center for Organ Transplantation.
items.description_ar: خدمة إلكترونية تمكن المستخدم من التسجيل كمتبرعين بالأعضاء بعد الوفاة، وإرسال البيانات للمركز السعودي لزراعة الأعضاء في سبيل إنقاذ المرضى المحتاجين دون الحاجة لمراجعة مقر الجهة.
items.notes: scot.gov.sa returned a server error (HTTP 500) on 2026-10-12, so the centre's own site could not be read. 'Languages' is the service language listed on my.gov.sa. Arabic name is shortened from 'التبرع بالأعضاء'.

items.name_en: Donate Safely - donation licence check (National Center for Non-Profit Sector)
items.name_ar: خدمة تبرع بأمان - المركز الوطني لتنمية القطاع غير الربحي
items.description_en: Check that a charity, campaign or collection channel holds a valid donation licence before you give.
items.description_ar: هي خدمة إلكترونية مقدمة للعموم تهدف إلى التحقق من جميع التراخيص، وقنوات الجمع والتسويق وسريانها.

items.description_en: No current official page or app for booking a blood donation could be confirmed; do not publish a link until checked.
items.notes: MoH's apps page (updated 8 Oct 2026) lists only Sehhaty and Mawared. The only 'Wateen / وتين' in the my.gov.sa app directory is a patient app of the Royal Commission for Jubail and Yanbu hospital. wateen.sa belongs to an unrelated private company. Blood donation may now sit inside Sehhaty, but I found no official page saying so. Arabic name is my wording.
